title: Alaska King Salmon Adventures
specs: Nushagak River has the largest king salmon run in Alaska with over 100,000 fish
Remote fly-in-only access keeps the river pristine and uncrowded
Expert guides with extensive hydrographical knowledge and Coast Guard licenses
Custom 23ft boats with 115hp outboards and quality fishing gear
Bring printed fishing license; King Salmon Stamp required for King fishing; children under 16 need catch record card but no license
All guides are Coast Guard licensed
includes: Round-trip airfare from Dillingham to the lodge
Deluxe camp accommodations with hot showers, flush toilets, and internet
blurb: Guests fly into Dillingham, then take a float plane to a remote fishing camp on the Nushagak River. The experience includes guided fishing for multiple salmon species and other fish, with expert guides and quality equipment. Deluxe camp accommodations include gourmet meals, hot showers, and internet access.
extraNote: 50% deposit required to hold reservation; final payment due Feb 1 if booked before Feb 1, otherwise 30 days after invoice · Booking early flight out of camp not recommended due to weather delays; late afternoon/evening flight out of Dillingham recommended · Accepts credit/debit cards, cash, or check · Dillingham airport and float plane lake; float plane picks up guests from their accommodation in Dillingham town. · June through August
